none: PAS NLM-196487: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Securitas Rei Publicae issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped, diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscriprtion: [---]PF AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS] REI PVBLICAE. Diameter (long axis): 19.1mm, Weight: 2.19gms, die axis: 12
